title: Pears in Wine
description: An elegant festive dessert: pears poached in red wine with cinnamon and clove, served with the reduced syrup.

instructions.title: Peel the pears
instructions.description: Peel the pears keeping the stem intact.

instructions.title: Prepare the wine
instructions.description: Boil the wine with the sugar, cinnamon, cloves and orange peel until the sugar dissolves.

instructions.title: Poach the pears
instructions.description: Add the pears and cook over a gentle heat for about 30 minutes until tender.

instructions.title: Reduce the syrup
instructions.description: Remove the pears and reduce the wine over high heat until it thickens into a syrup.

instructions.title: Serve
instructions.description: Serve the pears with the syrup, well chilled or at room temperature.
